messages:
Ava: Quick lunchtime micro-game — pick exactly three emojis that describe your luck today, then vote for lunch (react with the lunch emoji): 1) tacos :taco: 2) sushi :sushi: 3) mystery leftovers :mysterious_box:. Bonus: add a one-liner.
Sam: :four_leaf_clover: :coffee: :taco: — Feeling lucky and jittery. Tacos for lunch.
Priya: :sparkles: :sneezing_face: :sushi: — small miracles and allergies, sushi pls.
Jules: :shrug: :thinking_face: :popcorn: — emotionally neutral, popcorn for snack not lunch. (But I vote tacos anyway)
Marcus: :fire: :muscle: :taco: — power hour. Tacos. One-liner: "Calories are just pre-loved energy."
Ava: Love the streaks. Keeping a scoreboard: tacos 3, sushi 1, mystery 0.
Priya: Also quick ask — anyone wants to split an Uber from the office to the taco place at 12:15? I can drive if needed.
Jules: I’ll chip in for Uber. Meet at lobby 12:10.
Sam: I can’t leave the desk until 12:05, but will sprint. If someone grabs my taco, leave it on my desk.
Marcus: @Sam noted. I’ll grab an extra napkin and a burrito-sized apology.
OpsBot: Reminder: Lunch reimbursement policy — team lunches under $25 per person are eligible for one-time reimbursement. See <https://intranet/redwood/policies#lunch>
Ava: Nice! Two quick one-liners from me: "If the coffee’s strong, so are our opinions." and "Tacos: bringing teams together since forever"
Sam: One-liner: "Email is the adult version of 'do you want to hang out?'"
Priya: One-liner: "Plants are the only coworkers that never ask for status updates." :seedling: :laughing: 
Jules: One-liner: "If you can’t find the snack, check the plant."
Marcus: Ok let’s wrap — tacos win. Lobby 12:10, carpool thread in DMs. Thanks for playing the three-emoji luck game. Highly scientific. :trophy:
